class.name: IfcConstructionMaterialResource
class.brief_description: IfcConstructionMaterialResource identifies a material resource type in a construction project. HISTORY: New Entity in IFC Release 2.0. Base type and documentation extended in IFC2x4. IFC2x4 NOTE: The attribute Suppliers has been deleted; use IfcRelAssignsToResource to assign an IfcActor to fulfill the role as a supplier. The attribute UsageRatio has been deleted; use BaseQuantityConsumed and BaseQ

members.member: Defines types of construction material resources. IFC2x4 New attribute A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
